/pages/21/summary: Secure sign-in is intended for the approved production configuration; live access is not yet verified here. Your customer account uses only approved permissions within its own tenant. Signing in again does not start a new 24-hour trial.
/pages/21/sections/0/body: Secure sign-in is intended for the approved production configuration; live access is not yet verified here. Your customer account uses only approved permissions within its own tenant. Signing in again does not start a new 24-hour trial.
/pages/21/sections/1/body: When switching from the trial to an explicitly chosen, approved paid Suite plan, your account, tenant, workspace, settings, key references, documents, history and credit references are retained. There is no automatic conversion and no automatic charge at the end of the trial. The Suite trial includes no gifted LLM credit: LLM use requires validated BYOK or the one-time EUR 5 trial credit offered after operational and pricing approval.

/pages/22/summary: Public customer registration is intended. After your email is confirmed and your customer workspace is activated, you can start the 24-hour free Suite trial. LLM use is funded separately. Live registration is not yet verified here.
/pages/22/sections/0/body: Public customer registration is intended. After your email is confirmed and your customer workspace is activated, you can start the 24-hour free Suite trial. LLM use is funded separately. Live registration is not yet verified here.
/pages/22/sections/1/body: After email confirmation and activation, you start the trial explicitly. From that moment, a single 24-hour period runs by server time. Signing in again does not extend it. Your customer account receives permissions only within your own tenant; internal administrative rights are excluded.
/pages/22/sections/2/heading: LLM use: your own key or trial credit
/pages/22/sections/2/body: The free Suite trial includes no gifted LLM credit. You either use your own provider key (BYOK) at your own provider's expense, or a one-time EUR 5 (500 cents) paid trial credit for our managed route. The managed route and the provider selection are released only once available. In this preview, LLM use is not yet activated.
/pages/22/sections/3/body: Without an explicitly chosen and approved paid Suite plan, trial eligibility ends without an automatic charge. A trial top-up is not a Suite subscription. When you switch, your account, tenant, workspace, settings, key references, documents, history and credit references are retained. Purchased credit does not expire merely because the trial ends; your account and your data rights remain.
